entities.summary: Austin Manuel Hooper is an American professional football tight end for the Atlanta Falcons of the National Football League (NFL). He played college football for the Stanford Cardinal and was selected by the Falcons in the third round of the 2016 NFL draft. Hooper has also played for the Cleveland Browns, Tennessee Titans, Las Vegas Raiders, and New England Patriots.
